name: PACK IT [Swing and Deliver 📦]
desc:
📦 PACK IT! Sprint, slide, wall-run and grapple across the city and launch parcels into the back of the moving van!

🚚 Longer throws, perfect timing and delivery streaks = bigger tips
📋 Daily jobs and map contracts with cash bonuses and titles
🎨 Unlock grapple hooks, trails, parcel skins and emotes in the Locker
👥 Party up with up to 4 friends, or train solo

👑 VIP: +25% tips, 20% off the Locker, the Golden Grapple, Red Carpet trail, Black Card Case and a gold VIP name tag.

llm.loop: sprint, wall-run and grapple through the city -> throw parcels into a moving van -> earn tips and streaks -> complete jobs/contracts -> unlock grapple hooks and cosmetics
llm.objectives: deliver parcels for big tips and complete daily contracts
llm.progression: cash tips, daily jobs, titles, cosmetics
llm.instructions: grapple across city, throw parcels, party up to 4, complete daily jobs
unique: parkour mixed with throwing delivery minigame
llm.thumbnails: character swinging with grapple over container port with van and parcel
llm.complexity_notes: movement system, grapple physics, detailed map, 16 badges
